scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing geocaching as an inexpensive active hobby, [X] starts with low-difficulty, low-terrain caches and uses distance, pavement versus rough trail, weather, water crossings, and any climbing warning to decide when ordinary comfortable shoes remain enough and when sturdier hiking footwear becomes necessary.
examples: using Hiking only when the selected cache actually moves onto rough trails or steep terrain
keeping easy urban cache walks below a specialized-sport threshold
not converting optional swimming or climbing warnings into activities the beginner intends to do
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选择地理寻宝作为便宜且能活动身体的爱好时，[X]会从低难度、低地形等级的缓存开始，并依据距离、铺装路或崎岖小径、天气、涉水和攀爬警告，判断普通舒适鞋是否足够，还是需要更结实的徒步鞋。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After narrowing a North Carolina trip to an underground gold-mine visit and a round at Long Iron Golf, [X] separates closed-toe visitor safety from golf-specific stance and walking, treating an optional mountain trail as a third footwear role only if it remains in the itinerary.
examples: using Golf for the committed course session rather than for the whole trip
using Hiking only if the optional mountain stop is retained
deciding whether one versatile pair can cover the mine and course without pretending a specialist pair was purchased
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把北卡罗来纳行程缩小为地下金矿参观和 Long Iron Golf 球场活动后，[X]会在鞋履规划中分别处理封闭鞋头的参观安全与高尔夫站姿和步行；只有可选山地路线被保留时，才增加第三种专用鞋。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While following a sixteen-week walk-run plan toward a first 10K from no prior base, [X] measures both feet at home, chooses support and cushioning for progressive road mileage, orders only from a seller with reversible returns, and delays long sessions until the candidate shoe passes short indoor and outdoor checks.
examples: using Running for the explicit 10K progression
checking toe room, heel hold, and comfort before increasing distance
keeping the shoe at category level because no model is actually selected in the source
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从零基础按十六周走跑计划准备首次 10 公里时，[X]会先在家测量双脚，为逐步增加的公路里程选择支撑和缓震，只从可方便退货的商家下单，并在候选鞋通过短距离室内外检查前不用于长距离训练。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When the initial request asks only broadly about sports-shoe stores, [X] first establishes the actual activity, movement pattern, surface, weather, frequency, foot constraints, and return risk before comparing any retailer or model, allowing a later target sport to change the functional branch without inventing prior participation.
examples: separating sustained motion, court or field impact, terrain, snow or water, rhythm, precision, and animal-handling branches before search
requiring sport-specific size, support, traction, and return evidence rather than trusting a generic sports label
using the later target value as the shopper's intended activity, not as a claim that every activity was already practiced
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 起初只笼统询问去哪里购买运动鞋时，[X]会先明确真实活动、动作模式、场地、天气、频率、足部限制和退货风险，再比较商家或型号，使后续目标运动只改变功能分支，而不会虚构既往参与经历。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building consistency before speed as a new runner, [X] compares neutral, stability, and high-cushion shoe roles against short run-walk sessions, then uses hill heart-rate spikes, talk-test effort, soreness, and recovery to keep footwear support aligned with beginner training rather than treating shoes as a shortcut to performance.
examples: using Running for the established multi-week habit
slowing or walking slopes instead of asking footwear to compensate for excessive intensity
revisiting the shoe role if blisters, new pain, or uneven comfort disrupt consistency
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始跑步并先建立稳定习惯而不是追求速度时，[X]会在短时走跑训练中比较中性、稳定和高缓震三类跑鞋，再用坡段心率峰值、说话测试、酸痛和恢复情况，让鞋履支撑与初学训练相匹配，而不是把鞋当成提升表现的捷径。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo Maui trip with snorkeling, coastal history, and selected land excursions, [X] assigns separate water shoes or reef sandals and walking or trail shoes by wet entry, sharp or slippery shoreline, long site visits, and any retained hike rather than forcing one pair across incompatible water and land roles.
examples: using Water Sports for the explicit snorkeling and wet-entry role
using Hiking only for retained longer trails, not every historical-site walk
keeping resort sandals outside the sport role
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自前往毛伊岛并安排浮潜、海岸历史景点和已选陆上活动时，[X]会分别准备水鞋或礁石凉鞋与步行或徒步鞋，依据湿滑入水、尖锐或滑溜岸线、长时间参观及实际保留的徒步来分配，而不让一双鞋勉强兼顾冲突的水陆角色。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After choosing jazz dance classes, practicing basic steps, and completing a small performance, [X] buys professional jazz shoes and compares the familiar pair's freedom, floor contact, turning control, and fatigue across later classes without generalizing that response to other dance forms.
examples: using Dance for the explicitly chosen jazz course
tracking the purchased pair through repeated class movements
not relabeling the pair for running, court play, or outdoor terrain
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选择爵士舞课程、练习基本步伐并完成小型演出后，[X]会购买专业爵士舞鞋，并在后续课堂中比较这双熟悉鞋子的活动自由度、地面接触、转身控制和疲劳表现，同时不把这种体验泛化到其他舞种。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a weekend mountain climb with friends, [X] packs familiar hiking shoes and observes them through rugged ascent, a wet waterfall section, steeper slopes, summit time, and descent, using grip, foot movement, pressure, and wet recovery to judge whether the pair truly fits the hiking role.
examples: using Hiking for the completed mountain route
checking the same packed pair on ascent and descent
not upgrading the activity to technical climbing without ropes or a technical route
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与朋友进行周末登山时，[X]会装入熟悉的徒步鞋，并在崎岖上坡、瀑布潮湿路段、更陡坡面、山顶停留和下坡过程中观察抓地、脚在鞋内的移动、压痛和湿后恢复，以判断这双鞋是否真正适合徒步。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When beginning basketball through rules, dribbling, passing, shooting, defensive footwork, and repeated practice, [X] turns the learning sequence into a first shoe brief that prioritizes court traction, lateral containment, landing stability, and fit before basketball-fashion identity.
examples: using Basketball for the explicit beginner pathway
linking traction and containment to named court movements
keeping brand and style culture secondary until movement needs are established
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始通过规则、运球、传球、投篮、防守脚步和反复练习学习篮球时，[X]会把这一过程转化为首次选鞋需求，先确定球场抓地、横向包裹、落地稳定和合脚程度，再考虑篮球潮流风格。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing between Puma Speedcat ballet sneakers and Adidas Sambas for trend-forward or classic everyday styling with jeans, skirts, or trousers, [X] explicitly separates casual fashion use from footwear intended for running, court, field, trail, snow, water, dance, or other sport performance.
examples: using Not Intended for Sports for the stated everyday fashion role
not inferring motorsport performance from the Speedcat's driving-shoe aesthetic
not treating the Samba's sport heritage as evidence of current specialized use
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在 Puma Speedcat 芭蕾鞋型与 Adidas Samba 之间比较，为牛仔裤、裙子或长裤选择潮流感或经典日常搭配时，[X]会明确把这种休闲时尚用途与面向跑步、球场、田径场、山径、雪地、水上、舞蹈或其他运动表现的鞋履区分开。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A bicycle delivery worker who wants to skateboard after a shift separates steady work pedaling from explosive board movement, choosing footwear roles and session intensity around pedal contact, board feel, lateral control, accumulated leg fatigue, and recovery rather than expecting one generic sporty shoe to optimize both.
examples: using Cycling for the professional delivery movement
treating skateboarding as a distinct hobby demand even though it is outside the clean value list
shortening or lowering-impact practice after a heavy delivery day
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名自行车配送员想在下班后玩滑板，他把稳定的工作踩踏与爆发式板上动作分开，依据踏板接触、板感、横向控制、累积腿部疲劳和恢复来安排鞋履角色与练习强度，而不期待一双笼统的运动鞋同时优化两者。
